title: The natural coherent tensor-level comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme W in universe u, and n≥0. Use the specified ordinary coherent reduction r from completed-module sheaves to the ringed coefficient sequence site, simultaneous completed scalar restriction U, and the unit-normalized reduction evaluations a_n [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core]. Let Tot_s be the specified unbounded direct-sum sequence tensor, and let B_tensor,n be the actual finite tensor-level functor on pairs of arbitrary completed-module complexes [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Construct a natural isomorphism (r^c × r^c);Tot_s;U^c;e_n^c ≅ B_tensor,n. Its component at (P,Q) is exactly reordering, followed by scalar restriction of the prescribed evaluation tensor comparison κ_n, followed by scalar restriction of Tot_Bn(a_n(P) inverse,a_n(Q) inverse). Naturality is in both complex variables, and imposes no flatness, boundedness or horizontal transition hypothesis. This records a real composite of the specified natural isomorphisms; it does not assert compatibility of different n. The Lean signature types both sides as evaluation of the actual tower functors (including the complex-to-tower reordering on the source); these are the same displayed finite-level functors, with their concrete action on morphisms.

def pullbackTensorTensorLevelComparison (W : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    (((((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod
      ((pullbackTensorOrdinaryReduction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))) ⋙
      coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u}
        (coefficientSequenceTopology (ProEt.topology W))
        (coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E W) ⋙
      (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E W).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
      HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex) ⋙
      (evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ)).obj (op n) ≅
    integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E W ⋙
      (evaluation ℕᵒᵖ (CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E W) ℤ)).obj (op n)
